title: In-app agent umbrella 2: look sees clips, more image tools, lighter on a local GPU
description: UMBRELLA, Fabio 2026-09-26. Phases in plan.md: (1) a big batch is ONE job to the agent - one progress line, one report, no looks (built 2026-09-27); (2) MPI-948 a dragged gallery selection reaches the agent as ONE set chip; (3) MPI-904 agent image tools with no model: plain upscale (Siax for realism, AnimeSharp for cartoons), background removal, crop - moved up 2026-09-27; (4) look sees videos and GIFs through services/cardView.js viewFile(); (5) MPI-913 the agent's local Ollama model holds VRAM while its own generations run; (6) MPI-905 warn under 64K context, Ollama agent context 32K to 64K. Member cards stay on the board until their work lands here.
